name: RunningAverageNode
label: Running Average
description: Adds a column with the cumulative mean of a numeric column. The running average restarts for each partition.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to compute the running average for.

fields.name: ValueColumn
fields.label: Value Column
fields.description: The numeric column to average cumulatively.

fields.name: PartitionByColumns
fields.label: Partition By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns that define partitions. The running average restarts per partition.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the running average column. Defaults to '<ValueColumn>_RunningAverage'.
